name: artifact-workbench
description: A toolkit for creating and organizing an artifact library.

languageModelTools.name: artifact-workbench_create_category
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Allows user to create a category for artifacts. Categories should be a container for a specific element like a contact form with modular input fields or a cta banner that includes styling, javascript, and html content. If a specified category already exists, try a different name as name must be unique to each category.If a category exists that is relevant even if the name is different, artifacts should be added to the existing category without creating a new category to cut down on duplicate categories.

languageModelTools.name: artifact-workbench_remove_category
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Allows user to remove a category for artifacts. This tool will also delete all child artifacts of the specified category.

languageModelTools.name: artifact-workbench_create_artifact
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Allows user to create an artifact from provided code. Artifacts will be added to the provided category. Provided category must exist already and may need to be created before using this tool.

artifact.description: artifact name. e.g. form input (first name), carousel container, carousel-slide

type.description: the type of code snippet of the artifact. e.g. html, css, js

snippet.description: the code snippet to be included in the artifact

languageModelTools.name: artifact-workbench_modify_artifact
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Allows user to modify an artifact with provided values. Artifacts will be updated with non-null inputs and any null inputs will be ignored.

name.description: new artifact name. e.g. form input (first name), carousel container, carousel-slide

type.description: the type of code snippet of the artifact. e.g. html, css, js

snippet.description: the code snippet to be included in the artifact

languageModelTools.name: artifact-workbench_remove_artifact
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Allows user to remove an artifact from specified category.

artifact.description: artifact name. e.g. form input (first name), carousel container, carousel-slide

languageModelTools.name: artifact-workbench_copy_artifact
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Allows user to copy an artifact from one specified category to another. The artifact will be replicated to the destination category and remain in the source category as well.

artifact.description: artifact name. e.g. form input (first name), carousel container, carousel-slide

languageModelTools.name: artifact-workbench_move_artifact
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Allows user to move an artifact from one specified category to another. The artifact will be added to the destination category and removed from the source category.

artifact.description: artifact name. e.g. form input (first name), carousel container, carousel-slide
